CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

3. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

6. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

8. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

9. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

10. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

11. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.

12. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Netball.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
